interventions.detail: TF 1.x needs Python <=3.7; uv has no 3.7, so created a conda-forge python=3.7 env via micromamba
requirements.txt 'tensorflow>=1.11' resolves to TF2 (no tf.contrib); pinned tensorflow==1.15.5, protobuf==3.20.3, numpy<1.19, h5py<3
Converted HF safetensors weights to a TF1 bert_model.ckpt + bert_config.json with modeling.py variable names (tools/hf_to_tf1_ckpt.py)
